Harper - Marketing: Locking the publish plan for Monday. Need: (1) changelog URL, (2) docs canonical URL (no redirects), (3) webinar time + embargo, (4) UTMs. One-line replies please.

Noah - Eng: changelog: https://redwood-inference.dev/changelog/2026-10-05-release. No blockers. Canary planned post-deploy.

June - Docs: docs canonical: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/releases/2026-10-05. I'll add the tiny code sample after Noah posts it; ETA 30m.

Noah - Eng: snippet (use verbatim):
```js
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/sprint-7b', prompt: 'Summarize release highlights', max_tokens: 80 });
console.log(r.text);
```
Canary tested.

Iris - Growth: Webinar at 09:00 PT (join 08:55). Recommend embargo 08:55 PT. UTMs: utm_campaign=oct05_release&utm_source=webinar. Tag registrants lead_release=oct05.

Harper - Marketing: If deploy starts 05:00 PT will canary finish before embargo? Docs need to be live.

Noah - Eng: Deploy plan: 05:00 deploy -> 05:00-05:30 canary -> 05:30-06:30 progressive -> 07:00 full traffic. Buffer ok. Rollback path ready.

June - Docs: I'll merge the snippet and publish docs by 07:30 PT.

Iris - Growth: Landing modal copy: "Live demo: see latency + cost gains. Register." I'll push final modal and tracking to #growth.

Harper - Marketing: Final publish flow if green: 08:55 PT blog + changelog + docs live, 09:00 PT webinar, 09:05 PT social posts. React here :white_check_mark: to confirm.
